## listKeyPolicyIds() function

List the key ids that currently carry their own governance policy.

Reads only the ids, so it never has to decrypt policy documents — enough for management surfaces to show which keys are individually governed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function listKeyPolicyIds(): string[]
```

**Returns:**

string\[\]

Key ids with a stored policy, most recently updated first.
